Hello everyone:

Here is the wedding information you have all been waiting for with baited breath.

EFTA00980034

 Those of you who are staying at the Disney Yacht Club resort (all but two of you) should have received
your email confirmation from Disney regarding arrival and departure dates. Disneyworld is about 45
min from Orlando airport. There are free Disney shuttles from the airport, and taxis cost about $50.
You won't need a car on site as we are walking distance to Epcot and Hollywood theme parks and there
are shuttles to the monorail and other parks.

We sent you a few days ago an excel spreadsheet with the Disney Ticket Pass numbers assigned to your
name. (We are attaching it here again for your convenience) We have the physical cards with us, and
you can pick them up from us at the hotel (or hopefully at the reception desk when you check in). If
you want to plan things in advance you can set up an account at the web site below, and link your ticket
numbers with that account to allow you to make fast pass bookings for various rides. reserve
restaurants etc.

Meals:
Nancy and I have already made reservations for a number of meals. We have dinners and lunches set up
in various theme parks as you can see below. Our reservations at Marrakesh on Sunday eve and
Biergarten on Monday eve and lunch at the Crystal Palace on Wed will accommodate everyone who
wants to join us. These restaurants generally cost about $30-40 pp. The other reservations are for
smaller groups, so please contact us if you want to join us at those venues.

We will be having breakfasts at the hotel each morning at 9 am or so, and would be happy to have you
join us if you wish.
